question: Based on monthly sales data starting in January 2016 and using a centered moving average to adjust for seasonality, which products had a seasonality-adjusted sales ratio that stayed consistently above 2 for every month in the year 2017?

WITH monthly_data AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    CAST(mth AS DATE) as mth_date,
    qty as actual_sales,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mth_date) as month_num,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mth_date) as year
  FROM monthly_sales
  WHERE mth >= '2016-01-01' AND mth <= '2018-06-01'
),
lag_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    mth_date,
    actual_sales,
    year,
    month_num,
    LAG(actual_sales, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_minus_1,
    LAG(actual_sales, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_minus_2,
    LAG(actual_sales, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_minus_3,
    LAG(actual_sales, 4) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_minus_4,
    LAG(actual_sales, 5) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_minus_5,
    LAG(actual_sales, 6) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_minus_6,
    LEAD(actual_sales, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_plus_1,
    LEAD(actual_sales, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_plus_2,
    LEAD(actual_sales, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_plus_3,
    LEAD(actual_sales, 4) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_plus_4,
    LEAD(actual_sales, 5) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_plus_5,
    LEAD(actual_sales, 6) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth_date) as sales_plus_6
  FROM monthly_data
),
window1_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    mth_date,
    actual_sales,
    year,
    month_num,
    (sales_minus_1 + sales_minus_2 + sales_minus_3 + sales_minus_4 + sales_minus_5 + 
     sales_plus_1 + sales_plus_2 + sales_plus_3 + sales_plus_4 + sales_plus_5 + sales_plus_6) as w1_sum,
    11 as w1_count
  FROM lag_sales
),
window2_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    mth_date,
    actual_sales,
    year,
    month_num,
    (sales_minus_1 + sales_minus_2 + sales_minus_3 + sales_minus_4 + sales_minus_5 + sales_minus_6 +
     sales_plus_1 + sales_plus_2 + sales_plus_3 + sales_plus_4 + sales_plus_5) as w2_sum,
    11 as w2_count
  FROM lag_sales
),
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    w1.product_id,
    w1.mth,
    w1.mth_date,
    w1.actual_sales,
    w1.year,
    w1.month_num,
    (w1.w1_sum + w2.w2_sum) * 1.0 / (w1.w1_count + w2.w2_count) as cma
  FROM window1_calc w1
  JOIN window2_calc w2 ON 
    w1.product_id = w2.product_id AND
    w1.mth = w2.mth AND
    w1.mth_date = w2.mth_date
),
final_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    mth_date,
    actual_sales,
    year,
    cma,
    actual_sales * 1.0 / cma as sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM cma_calc
),
product_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    MIN(sales_to_cma_ratio) as min_ratio,
    MAX(sales_to_cma_ratio) as max_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as month_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sales_to_cma_ratio > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as months_above_2
  FROM final_calc
  WHERE year = 2017
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT 
  product_id,
  min_ratio,
  max_ratio,
  month_count,
  months_above_2
FROM product_stats
ORDER BY months_above_2 DESC, product_id
